verdict.rationale: Rippling documents accounting-system integrations (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite) and a general developer API/platform with sandbox access, which could support pulling payroll data programmatically, but there is no specific mention of a payroll journal export/API or reconciliation workflow, nor any agent-oriented tooling for this task. missing for 10: dedicated payroll journal/export API documentation, explicit reconciliation workflow support, evidence of agent/AI-driven use of these APIs for ledger reconciliation.
